Subject: Calibration summit logistics + comp sync: manager note redaction protocol

Team —

Putting this thread together to lock the logistics and privacy controls for the calibration summit (week of 6/21). Key asks:

1) Finalize summit agenda and speaker roster (attached: summit_agenda_v1.pdf, speakers_list.csv).
2) Confirm cross-region comp sync slot — we need a 30-minute block that works for US/EU.
3) Agree on a manager-note redaction protocol so excerpts shared with ICs are scrubbed for PII and sensitive feedback. Draft redaction template attached (redaction_guidelines.xlsx).
4) Pilot: propose a small quiet-rollout for one director team the week prior (6/14) to validate tooling and redaction.

Amy (cc'd) — can PeopleOps help validate the redaction checklist and confirm any legal gaps?

Deliverables I want by EOD Friday 5/21: updated agenda, final speaker list, and manager questionnaire (see attached). If we can lock the comp sync time now I will reserve the calendar.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Talent Ops
Redwood Inference

+1 on the agenda overall. A couple of notes:

- For comp sync, prefer 8:00–8:30am PT / 5:00–5:30pm CET as that keeps it early for US leadership and late-but-still-workable for EU.
- On redaction: we should standardize the fields that are never shared (salary ranges, performance improvement plan language, verbatim peer feedback). The attached redaction sheet is a good start; I'll add an explicit column for "legal review required".
- Suggest the quiet pilot include one director + two managers so we have a small cross-section of note styles.

I'll update the agenda with a compensation sync placeholder and a 15-minute QA slot after the redaction walk-through.
